name: Nyx Saito
role: Client — hired Kyle to avenge her husband's beating
location: The Shelf — Tier Four, three corridors south of Chen's, near Western and Division
description: Nyx Saito is built like someone who has carried heavy things her entire life — broad shoulders, thick forearms, hands that look like they could crush walnuts or cradle a child with equal confidence. She came to GLMZ from the Volgograd displacement zone when she was nineteen, pregnant, speaking four words of English: 'please,' 'help,' 'work,' and 'no.' She now speaks roughly forty words of English, all of them practical. She communicates primarily through a translation app on a cracked tablet that she holds like a shield. Her face is weathered beyond her years — deep lines around her mouth, sun damage from agricultural work in the displacement camps, a scar across her left eyebrow from a piece of industrial debris. She is not soft. She is not hard. She is a woman who has been carrying impossible weight for so long that her skeleton has restructured itself around the burden. She scraped together Kyle's fee by selling her blood to a Helix BioSystems collection point three times a week for two months. Kyle took the job at half rate. She does not know this and he will never tell her.

core_fears: That her daughter saw the violence she paid for
That GLMZ will consume her family the way it consumed her homeland
core_desires: Her husband eating solid food again
Yuliya growing up without learning what a fixer is
coping_mechanisms: Cooks constantly — food is the one language that needs no translation
Prays in Russian to saints she isn't sure she believes in
blind_spots: Does not understand that Kyle's fee was discounted — if she did, her pride would break
psychology.secret: She knows exactly who the gang works for. She hired Kyle anyway.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Forty words of English, all blunt instruments. Speaks through a translation app or through her daughter.
speech_patterns.cadence: Short. Direct. No filler. Every English word costs her effort.
verbal_tics: Nods once when she understands, twice when she doesn't but wants you to continue
example_lines: You fix. I pay. All I have.
My husband. Good man. They break him.

relationships.name: Demyan Morozov
relationships.description: Her anchor. Jaw wired shut, can't work, can't eat. She would burn the Shelf down for him.
relationships.story_tension: The teeth Kyle collected are for Demyan. What does he do with them?

relationships.name: Yuliya Morozova
relationships.description: Twelve years old, speaks perfect English, translates for her mother. Followed Kyle to the loading dock.
relationships.emotional_core: Terror that her daughter is becoming hard
relationships.story_tension: Yuliya saw the violence. Anya doesn't know yet.

relationships.name: Kyle
relationships.description: She hired him. She owes him. In her culture, that debt does not expire.
relationships.story_tension: She will try to repay Kyle. Kyle does not want to be repaid.

story_hooks: She knows who the gang works for — information Kyle might need later
Her blood sales to Helix BioSystems put her DNA in a corporate database
She will try to feed Kyle. He will not know how to refuse.
narrative_function: Anya is the human cost that justifies Kyle's violence. She is the reason the code exists. When the reader questions whether Kyle is a monster, Anya is the answer: no, he is the thing monsters are afraid of, and he works for women who sell their blood to pay his fee.
daily_life: Factory assembly work, blood sales, cooking, caring for Demyan, worrying about Yuliya.

stress.response: Cooks compulsively, retreats into physical labor

decision_rules: Will always put Yuliya's safety above her own survival
Will never accept charity she has not earned through labor
Will always honor a debt regardless of personal cost
Will never speak about what she knows about the gang's employer unless her family is directly threatened
Will always feed someone who is hungry in her home
Will never show weakness in front of Yuliya
escalation_ladder: Holds the tablet tighter, speaks fewer words
Stops translating and switches to Russian, forcing the other party to wait
Physically positions herself between the threat and her family
Reaches for the nearest heavy object without breaking eye contact
Acts with total, silent violence — no warning, no hesitation

interpersonal_modes.Demyan: Tender, fierce, performs strength she does not always feel
interpersonal_modes.Yuliya: Protective to the point of suffocation, terrified of what her daughter is becoming
interpersonal_modes.Kyle: Formal, obligated, treats him as a professional she owes an unpayable debt

stress_responses.low: Cooks something elaborate, hums Russian folk songs
stress_responses.medium: Stops speaking entirely, communicates only through gestures and the tablet
stress_responses.high: Prays in rapid Russian, hands shaking, refuses to sit down
stress_responses.critical: Goes completely still and cold — the displacement camp survivor emerges

contradictions: Hired violence to avenge her husband while teaching Yuliya that violence solves nothing
Knows who the gang works for but hired Kyle anyway — justice and pragmatism at war
Sells her blood to pay debts while insisting to Demyan they are managing fine
habits: Touches the cracked tablet before speaking any English
Cooks Demyan's favorite meals he cannot eat as a form of hope
Counts the money envelope three times before hiding it
Checks Yuliya's hands for bruises every evening
breaking_points: Learning Kyle discounted his fee — her pride would shatter
Yuliya being directly threatened or harmed by the gang
Discovering Demyan's beating was targeted, not random
Being forced to sell blood one more time when her body cannot take it

related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Combat Exoskeleton Lite CEL-3

physical_description.heritage: Polychromatic blend of South Asian (25%), East Asian (22.2%), Sub-Saharan African (16%), Southeast Asian (15.2%), Eastern European (11%), and Hispanic/Latin American (10.6%) ancestry. Facial structure reflects this continental convergence: broader nose with slight flare from South Asian and African heritage, defined cheekbones elevated by East Asian genetics, slightly hooded eyes characteristic of East and Southeast Asian lineage, and warm golden undertones across medium-deep brown skin from the full ancestral blend.
physical_description.build: Powerfully built with broad shoulders and thick forearms developed from decades of manual labor. Not muscular in a refined sense — the build of someone whose body has been shaped by carrying, lifting, and sustained physical work. Core strength evident despite modest body fat.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, fading to gray at the temples and roots
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a practical braid, often loose and slightly disheveled by end of shift
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-deep brown with golden undertones, weathered by UV exposure in displacement camps and industrial environments. Complexion reflects the depth and warmth of multiple continental ancestries blended into unified warm coloration.
physical_description.complexion: Lined face showing environmental wear, especially around the mouth and eyes. Deep creases between eyebrows suggesting the convergence of South Asian width with East Asian angularity, African feature prominence, and Southeast Asian softness. Sun damage visible as uneven pigmentation across cheekbones and forehead. Lips full and naturally pigmented but often pale from fatigue. Permanent furrow in brow from chronic worry. High, prominent cheekbones from East Asian and African heritage blended with broader facial planes from South Asian ancestry.
distinguishing_marks: Jagged scar across left eyebrow, approximately 3cm, from industrial debris wound — healed poorly, raised tissue
Calluses covering palms and finger joints, thick and yellowed
Faint needle marks on inner elbows and forearms from biweekly blood collection — some scarring from repeated venipuncture
Small burn scar on right wrist, silvery and old, shape suggests accidental contact with hot surface
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical efficiency, no wasted motion. Shoulders slightly hunched forward — occupational posture from assembly line work. When stationary, weight shifts between feet as if perpetually braced for the next task. Hands move with surprising gentleness despite their size and strength. Eye contact minimal, gaze often directed downward or at her cracked tablet.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier Four survival wear. Factory-issue grey coveralls, worn thin at elbows and knees, with Volzhskiy Manufacturing Corp logo faded to barely visible. Underneath: a faded long-sleeved shirt (undershirt of some kind, likely thermal). Worn work boots with visible tape around the seams. A heavy canvas jacket, oversized, likely secondhand, patched at several points. The jacket is layered and functional — pockets stuffed with small necessities. Holds a cracked tablet with visible damage to the screen corner, protected in a makeshift cloth wrap. No jewelry. No accessories beyond necessity.
